title: Pax Universe celestial bodies (data/bodies.json or data/bodies.patch.json)

системы.description: Star systems. The Solar System is always index 0 and does not need to be listed.

пояса.description: Asteroid belts drawn as instanced rocks.

params.description: Climate scales 0..1 used by simulation and the planet shader.

urban.description: How built-up. >0.01 lets a colony appear.

имя.description: Id and default name. Display name per language: key "тело_<имя>" in data/lang.

род.description: камень — rocky (colonies, provinces), газ — gas giant, звезда — star

a.description: Orbit radius, km, around the parent ("спутник") or the system centre. 0 — at the centre.

угол.description: Starting angle on the orbit, degrees

период.description: Orbital period, days. Optional for bodies around a star (Kepler from the star mass); needed for moons of non-Solar bodies.

спутник.description: Parent body id (moon of a planet, planet of a secondary star). Must be listed earlier. Inherits the parent's system.

система.description: Star system name from "системы". Empty — the Solar System.

дом.description: The player's home planet. Only one body may have it.

карта.description: Surface maps. Game name ("mars" → res://maps/mars_albedo.jpg) or a mod path without suffix: "res://mods/<id>/planets/xeno" → xeno_albedo.png, xeno_height.png (white = high), xeno_ocean.png (white = water). Equirectangular 2:1.

карта_море.description: Sea level on the height map.

высота_радуга.description: 1 — colour the height map as a rainbow (for airless bodies).

цвет_породы.description: Rock colour for bodies without maps, [r, g, b] 0..1.

кольца.description: Rings [inner km, outer km] from the centre.

шейдер_параметры.description: Shader uniforms: number, [r,g,b] (vec3 or source_color), [x,y,z,w], or an image path. Stars: core, edge — colours.

меш.description: A glb/gltf model instead of a sphere (asteroid, station, Dyson swarm…): res://mods/<id>/models/x.glb

звезда.description: Id of the central star body (add it to "тела" with "система" and "a": 0).

положение_св_лет.description: Position relative to the Sun, light years [x, y, z].
